name: kb_1156_Normalized

schema.description: WebhookThrottleConfig holds the configuration for throttling events

burst.description: ThrottleBurst is the maximum number of events sent at the same moment default 15 QPS

qps.description: ThrottleQPS maximum number of batches per second default 10 QPS

description: The webhook throttling parameters have been updated to better accommodate our current traffic load. The burst limit – the maximum number of events that can be dispatched simultaneously – is now set to 20. Meanwhile, the QPS (queries per second) cap, which governs the maximum number of event batches processed each second, has been increased to 12. These adjustments should provide a smoother flow of webhook deliveries while preventing overload.
